page.layout: One page of text. Running head at the top with the page number at its left. Below it, one paragraph of the date and place line in heavy type. Then the word FINIS, centred, in spaced capitals. No margin notes, no catchword, no signature.
page.running_head: Summa Controv. Lib. XI. De Gratia[?]

main_text.p: A. MDCXXXI[?] Iⅆ. XIX. Augusti, Lim-burgi, inter Godefridum Hottonum, cum Ioh. Iacobo du Bois, notario Henrico Blanchetefte, & partis Pontificis Matthiam Hauzeur, & Iohannem Pery: de invocatione Sanctorum.

page.notes: The date line is badly blurred. The Roman numerals of the year and day are doubtful: "cl3 I>c xxxı ı ı." was read as MDCXXXI, with the day given as XIX. The running head is blurred and the words "Contro." and "Gracia" are doubtful. The word FINIS is set in spaced capitals; it is not a heading. Scattered specks on the page are not printed text and are left out.
